body.prompt: A Korean father in his sixties and his adult son in his thirties sitting at a kitchen table sharing a simple breakfast in warm morning light, the father smiling softly, a quiet warm moment. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
